definition: The finite coordinate set used by the witness.
runtime_analogue: support_size field in support normal form
reduction_relevance: Determines whether support<=8 theorem can apply.
caveat: Support set equality is mathematical, not just row equality.

definition: Coordinates used by obstruction, shell/tail, or family-chain components.
runtime_analogue: canonical support row plus obstruction descriptors
reduction_relevance: Only inactive coordinates are deletion candidates.
family_chain_relevance: Active family coordinates may require lift.
higher_support_relevance: If all extra coordinates are active and no lift applies, escape remains.
caveat: Active/nonactive split still needs preservation lemma.

definition: Support coordinates not used by the normalized obstruction.
reduction_relevance: If proved redundant, deletion reduces support.
higher_support_relevance: Failure to find redundancy does not prove irreducibility globally.

definition: Coordinates whose deletion changes the counterexample witness.
reduction_relevance: Reduction must preserve these or replace by smaller witness.
family_chain_relevance: Family coordinates may be essential only after lift.
higher_support_relevance: All extra essential coordinates can trigger higher-support escape.

definition: Component matching bounded family-chain obstruction language.
reduction_relevance: Can absorb support growth only with family-chain support lift.
higher_support_relevance: If lift missing, remains named escape branch.
caveat: 7/7 freshness is not itself the lift.

definition: Frontier, shell, and tail descriptors attached to the witness.
mathematical_role: route into limited theorem if support<=8
reduction_relevance: Reduction output must stay in selected shell/tail language.
higher_support_relevance: If outside support8 language, higher-support escape remains.
caveat: No arbitrary shell/tail generalization is claimed.

definition: Canonical motif row used to compare witnesses.
reduction_relevance: Compression can reduce canonical rank if support size unchanged.
higher_support_relevance: If no compression applies, escape classification may remain.

definition: The theorem-preserving obstruction or escape payload carried by the witness.
reduction_relevance: Reduction must preserve or produce smaller obstruction witness.
caveat: Preservation proof is missing for general support operations.

definition: There is a redundant/equivalent/projectable coordinate or liftable family component.
higher_support_relevance: Absent condition routes to irreducible escape.
caveat: Existence of such a condition is not proved for all witnesses.

definition: No declared reduction operation precondition is satisfied.
family_chain_relevance: Family lift failure is separated before this trigger.
caveat: Classification is not a closure theorem.
